_doc: Genre pool, tag vocabulary and cooldown rules. Every history[] entry in gameaday-state.json is tagged with one value per dimension below; scripts/check-state.py enforces the rules. You may ADD new vocabulary entries (with a description) but never remove or rename existing ones.

genre.breakout: paddle deflects a ball into breakable bricks
genre.arena-shooter: move and shoot in a bounded arena against waves
genre.platformer: run and jump through side-on levels
genre.metroidvania: interconnected map gated by acquired abilities
genre.roguelike-dungeon: procedural grid dungeon, permadeath, turn-based combat
genre.deckbuilder: build a card deck over a run, play cards to fight
genre.tower-defense: place towers along paths to stop waves
genre.rts-lite: command units and gather resources in real time
genre.city-builder: zone, build and balance a growing settlement
genre.colony-sim: autonomous agents with needs; player directs priorities
genre.factory-automation: chain machines and belts to produce goods
genre.farming-life-sim: plant, tend, harvest across days and seasons
genre.tactics: turn-based squad combat on a grid
genre.puzzle-logic: deduction or constraint puzzles (sokoban, nonogram, etc.)
genre.puzzle-physics: solve levels with simulated physics objects
genre.match-3: swap tiles to form matches with cascades
genre.rhythm: act in time with a generated beat
genre.racing: race vehicles around a track against rivals or clock
genre.sports: a stylised ball or competitive sport
genre.fighting: 1v1 close combat with moves and combos
genre.stealth: avoid detection by patrolling guards with vision cones
genre.survival-crafting: gather, craft and survive environmental threats
genre.physics-toy: build or launch things in a physics playground
genre.artillery: turn-based angle/power ballistic duels on terrain
genre.snake-like: growing body navigation on a field
genre.maze-chase: navigate a maze while chased by AI pursuers
genre.idle-incremental: exponential economy with upgrades and prestige
genre.management-tycoon: run a business with pricing, staff and customers
genre.trading-economy: buy low, sell high across a dynamic market map
genre.board-game: digital board game vs AI opponent
genre.card-game: non-deckbuilding card game vs AI (solitaire, trick-taking)
genre.word-game: build or guess words under constraints
genre.interactive-fiction: branching narrative with state and choices
genre.golf-minigolf: aim and power shots across holes
genre.ecosystem-god-game: shape terrain and weather to guide a population

core_verb.jump: traverse via jumping and air control
core_verb.aim-launch: set angle and power, then release
core_verb.time: press on a beat or timing window
core_verb.draw: draw lines or shapes that become game objects
core_verb.choose: select between narrative or card options
core_verb.stack: arrange pieces into stable or complete configurations
core_verb.navigate: find a path through a space under pressure
core_verb.grow: expand or evolve something over time

perspective.third-person-3d: 3D with a chase or orbit camera
perspective.card-table: cards/UI on a table, little spatial movement

pacing.real-time-with-pause: real time but pausable to issue orders
pacing.rhythm-timed: locked to a beat or tempo

input.gamepad-style: few buttons, designed like a controller

structure.open-sandbox: no fixed goal; player sets objectives

win_condition.reach-goal: get to an exit or finish line
win_condition.reach-ending: reach one of the story endings
